title: Claude Code Memory: Give Your Agent Persistent Context Across Sessions
summary: Claude Code memory explained: CLAUDE.md, auto memory, and MEMORY.md give your agent persistent context across sessions. Step-by-step setup guide.
body_markdown: CLAUDE.md is written by you — it contains rules, conventions, and instructions you want Claude to follow every session. Auto memory is written by Claude — it contains patterns and preferences it has detected during past sessions. CLAUDE.md is deterministic and under your control. Auto memory is probabilistic; Claude decides what is worth saving based on recurrence, stability, and project specificity.
